clues.text: This coal town sits just north of the Arctic Circle in Russia. It lies in a coal basin by a river.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside the far north of Russia

clues.text: This town holds the cold record for the whole of Europe. Its coldest weather hit fifty two degrees below zero.
clues.narrowing: rules out every other European town on cold alone

source.quote: It has the coldest recorded temperature of any European city, at −52 °C (−61 °F).

clues.text: This hillside town sits in the highlands of southern Tanzania in East Africa. It lies south of the city of Mbeya.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside southern Tanzania

source.quote: is a hillside town that lies about 36 miles (58 km) south of the city of Mbeya, at an elevation of around 5,000 ft (1,500 m) in the highland Rungwe District of southern Tanzania, East Africa.

clues.text: Rain falls here almost all through the year. It comes from Lake Nyasa, and it keeps the hills green all year.
clues.narrowing: rules out dry parts of the south with short rains

source.quote: The town and the surrounding areas are green all year round due to the almost year-round convectional rains resulting from Lake Nyasa.

clues.text: Long ago this land was ruled by Germany. In those days the town went by a German name.
clues.narrowing: rules out towns never held under German rule

source.quote: formerly known as Neu Langenburg during the German's colonial rule

clues.text: People here speak a local tongue called Nyakyusa. They also speak Swahili, the tongue of the whole country.
clues.narrowing: rules out towns where Nyakyusa is not the local tongue

source.quote: The local language is Nyakyusa, together with the national language Swahili.

clues.text: Here the air stays mild to cool all year. It can drop to ten degrees in May and June.
clues.narrowing: confirms the cool highland town in the south

source.quote: Tukuyu has a moderate to cool temperature ranging from 10 °C in May and June to mid 20 °C in around November.
